summary: Toyota Motor Credit Corporation (TMCC) filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announced the resignation of Brittany Baird as principal accounting officer effective June 29, 2026, due to her appointment as CFO of Toyota Financial Savings Bank. The board appointed Carlos Adrian Gruebler, who served as interim chief accounting officer since February 2026, as vice president and chief accounting officer and principal accounting officer effective the same date, as a routine executive change. No financial terms, premium, or deal structure apply; watch for any subsequent shifts in accounting leadership or financial reporting stability.
